name: EXM_SPLIT_ALLOCATION_SETS
description: This table contains information about split allocation sets of expense items in expense reports.

columns.name: SPLIT_ALLOCATION_SET_ID
columns.description: Specific split allocation set identifier.

columns.name: SPLIT_ALLOCATION_SET_NAME
columns.description: Name of the specific split allocation set.

columns.name: SPLIT_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the code of the method used for split allocation, such as split by percentage or amount.

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person who created the split allocation set.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: SPLIT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code that identifies split type. Values are from lookup ORA_EXM_SPLIT_TYPES.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
